line.name: AVO Expresivo
line.description: Site already lists AVO with 14 other lines - this is a new line, not a new brand. CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL ASSUMPTION: the Mac folder's 'Exp' prefix was assumed to mean 'AVO Expression,' a long-running line - research found no line by that name. The real product is 'AVO Expresivo,' a BRAND-NEW regular-production line debuting at PCA 2026, launching in US stores June 25, 2026 - the opposite of long-running. It is the first AVO made outside the Dominican Republic, produced at Davidoff's Diadema Cigars de Honduras factory. Marketed as a fuller-flavored, accessible sub-premium entry, framed as 'a new chapter for AVO.' FLAG: since this is a mid-2026 launch, confirm the Mac photo's provenance/date aligns with this release before treating it as a settled catalog entry.
line.factory: Diadema Cigars de Honduras S.A., Honduras
